title: Pica AI Face Swap review: pricing & alternatives
summary: A current Pica AI Face Swap review covering photo and video swaps, pricing, credits, privacy, licensing, limitations, and the best alternatives.
body_markdown:
## Quick answer


**Pica AI is best for casual photo and video face swaps plus headshots and simple photo tools in one account.**


Its strongest appeal is low-friction access, but pricing varies by platform and its published Terms require careful review for commercial work. Magic Hour is the better fit for creators who need a broader, production-oriented face-swap and media workflow.


This documentation-based review was checked against Pica AI’s official product, price, Terms, privacy and refund pages on September 21, 2026. It does not claim a controlled quality test. Magic Hour publishes this guide and is included as an alternative.


## Pica AI at a glance


**Best for:** casual photo swaps, video swaps, AI headshots and quick portrait experiments. **Platforms:** browser and mobile apps. **Pricing:** free access plus subscriptions and credit purchases, with current amounts requiring live verification. **Main caveat:** licensing, refund and billing terms matter more than the simple interface suggests.


Pica AI is a consumer visual-tool bundle rather than one foundation model. Its current surfaces combine face swap, video face swap, multiple-face workflows, headshots, photo enhancement and restoration. Some enhancement functionality has also been connected to Artguru, so users should distinguish the product interface from the underlying service used for a specific task.


## How Pica AI Face Swap works


Choose photo or video face swap, upload a clear source identity, then upload the target. For group media, select or map the faces you intend to replace. Process the job, inspect the full output and download only after checking every person and frame.


Start with a source face that is sharp, well lit and unobstructed. Match head angle and expression when possible. Video adds harder problems: motion blur, profile turns, occlusion, fast cuts and changing light. Review the entire clip, not one poster frame.


## What Pica AI does well


Pica AI reduces setup. Casual users can move from upload to result without installing local software, selecting a model or building a node graph. Photo, video and group face swap are presented as separate tasks, which makes the intended workflow easier to understand.


The surrounding portrait tools are useful when the goal is experimentation rather than a single production pipeline. A user can try a swap, generate headshots, restore a photo or enhance an image from the same account.


## Where Pica AI is weaker


The product is less transparent than a production API or local workflow. Buyers should verify exact credits per task, queue behavior, output limits, watermark rules, retention and whether failed jobs consume credits. Do not assume mobile and web prices or entitlements are identical.


For commercial use, the published Terms deserve special attention. They may grant a personal, non-commercial license unless another plan or written agreement applies. Marketing copy, a download button or a paid subscription does not override the current legal terms. Teams should obtain written confirmation for their intended use.


## Pica AI pricing and credits


Pica AI’s[official price page](https://www.pica-ai.com/price/) lists free access and paid credit options, but prices and allowances can change across web, iOS, Android, region and promotion. Review the final checkout surface before paying. Record the renewal interval, included credits, expiration, watermark, output resolution and cancellation method.


Price the accepted result rather than the advertised run. If a video requires four attempts, manual cleanup and a second export, all of that belongs in cost. Also verify whether photo face swap, multi-face, video, headshots and enhancement draw from the same balance at the same rate.


## Refunds, subscriptions and licensing


Pica AI publishes a separate[refund policy](https://www.pica-ai.com/refund-policy.html) . It limits refunds and treats some services, including generated headshots, differently. Read it before buying a large pack or subscription. App-store purchases can also be governed by Apple or Google billing processes.


The[Terms of Service](https://www.pica-ai.com/terms-of-service.html) govern permitted use, subscriptions and content. If you need client, advertising, ecommerce or other commercial output, confirm that your exact plan grants that use. Keep a copy of the terms and checkout shown at purchase.


## Privacy and facial images


Pica AI’s[privacy policy](https://www.pica-ai.com/privacy-policy.html) describes collection, service providers, retention and user rights. Face-swap inputs are sensitive because they identify real people even when a jurisdiction does not classify every image as biometric data.


Use consented material, remove unnecessary metadata, avoid confidential client assets until retention is understood, and delete stored projects when finished. Never use face swap for impersonation, fraud, non-consensual intimate media, harassment or deceptive endorsements.


## Pica AI versus Magic Hour


**Pica AI:** Casual face swaps and portrait tools. Photo face swap: Yes. Video face swap: Yes. Caveat: Commercial rights and billing need careful verification. **Magic Hour:** Photo and video face swap inside a broader media workspace. Photo face swap: Yes. Video face swap: Yes. Caveat: Best results still require clear inputs and full review.


**Choose Pica AI for casual face-swap and portrait experiments. Choose Magic Hour when face swap is part of a broader image, video, lip-sync, talking-photo or audio production workflow.**


### Test one consented video


Use a clip with turns, occlusion and changing light. Review every frame, not only the preview image.


[Try Face Swap Free](https://magichour.ai/products/face-swap)


## Best Pica AI alternatives


**Magic Hour** is the best overall alternative for photo and video face swap plus broader creative workflows. Start with[Magic Hour Face Swap](https://magichour.ai/products/face-swap) .


**FaceFusion** fits technical users who want local control, model choices and a configurable workflow. Installation, hardware and responsible-use controls become the user’s responsibility.


**Pixlr** fits a simple still-photo swap followed by ordinary browser editing. Its official Face Swap workflow is narrower and currently displays a two-credit run cost.


**Remaker and Reface** remain relevant because many users search for migration and replacement options. Verify their current availability, pricing and terms instead of relying on old comparison tables.


## How to compare Pica AI fairly


Build a consented set with a front-facing photo, three-quarter pose, glasses, partial occlusion, group image and ten-second video with movement. Use the same source identity and target media everywhere. Define acceptable identity, pose preservation, boundary quality and frame consistency before testing.


Record credits, elapsed time, queue failures, resolution, watermark, correction time and accepted outputs. For video, inspect frame transitions, profile turns and moments when the subject passes behind an object. Cost per accepted result is more useful than cost per click.


## Common Pica AI problems and fixes


**A photo swap loses identity.** Use a larger, sharper source face with neutral lighting. Match the target’s head angle and expression. If the target is heavily stylized, compressed or partly hidden, test a cleaner target before spending more credits.


**A video looks good in one frame but flickers.** Watch the complete clip at normal speed and frame by frame around turns, cuts and occlusion. Shorten the clip or select footage with a more visible face. Do not approve a video from its thumbnail.


**A group swap replaces the wrong person.** Verify face mapping before processing and check every person afterward. Keep a source label for each identity so repeated attempts do not reverse assignments.


**The paid result cannot be used commercially.** Stop before publishing. Check the current Terms, the plan shown at purchase and any written support confirmation. Editing a result later does not fix a missing license.


## Who should use Pica AI?


Pica AI fits casual creators who want simple access to photo swaps, video swaps, group edits and portrait utilities without technical setup. The product is easiest to justify when the work is personal, experimental and low volume, and when the user is comfortable checking each result.


Choose another route when commercial rights must be unambiguous, programmatic access is required, a large video batch needs predictable operations, or sensitive assets require a stricter data review. Local tools trade convenience for control; production APIs trade consumer simplicity for documented integration behavior.


## Decision checklist


Confirm the exact deliverable, source consent, photo or video duration, number of identities, plan price, credit cost, refund eligibility, commercial license, output resolution, watermark and retention terms. Run one representative job before an annual purchase. Pica AI earns a shortlist place when ease and tool breadth matter more than API control or enterprise policy guarantees.


## A safer production workflow


Create a project folder with the consent record, untouched source files, target files, selected plan, policy links and the date checked. Use descriptive filenames for each identity and attempt. Never overwrite the original. After generation, review the output at delivery resolution and have a second person inspect high-risk commercial work.


For video, note every cut, profile turn and occlusion before processing. Review those moments first, then watch the clip from beginning to end with sound. Keep the accepted export and delete rejected identity-bearing files from local storage and the vendor account when controls allow.


If the media could be mistaken for a real event or endorsement, add a clear disclosure. A technically realistic swap can still be misleading. The creator remains responsible for consent, context and distribution even when the software makes the edit easy.


## Verdict


Pica AI is easy to approach and broad enough for casual portrait experimentation. Its face-swap coverage is more complete than photo-only tools because it includes video and group workflows. The buying risk is policy clarity: confirm live price, refund eligibility and commercial rights. Magic Hour is the stronger fit when the task extends beyond one swap into an ongoing media workflow.
